title: THE HELD GUN CASTS A SHADOW
why: Art build step 5 (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The brief asks for a soft cast shadow and a gun shadow. The held gun now throws a soft dark strip on the body and far arm beneath it, lit from the top left, drawn under the gun sprite so it costs one fill.
now: Guns in hand now cast a soft shadow on the body under them.
